# arin_org (Data Source)

Read an existing ARIN organization by its handle using Reg-RWS. This data source does not modify the organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "arin_org" "example" {
  handle = "EXAMPLE-1"
}

output "organization_name" {
  value = data.arin_org.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `handle` (String) Organization handle, for example `EXAMPLE-1`.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Registered organization name.
- `registration_date` (String) Registration date as returned by ARIN; no date format conversion is applied.
